sectors.name: Telecommunications (state PUC regulation)
sectors.what_established: In studied state telecom contexts, campaign contribution patterns associate with measurable PUC regulatory outcomes.
sectors.what_not_established: That economic concentration nationally weakens democratic accountability; that money 'buys' or 'owns' regulators as universal law.
sectors.capture_bar: NOT MET for a CC canonical 'capture' claim — association ≠ capture wording.
sectors.arkansas_note: Not Arkansas-specific; transfer requires state PUC modules later if needed.

sectors.name: Banking regulation / lobbying
sectors.evidence_type: MIXED — survey consistency with capture-like patterns + contrary revolving-door evidence
sectors.what_established: Substantial literature links bank lobbying to softer regulatory posture in some designs; revolving-door worker flows do not cleanly support quid-pro-quo capture.
sectors.what_not_established: A single national banking-capture verdict; revolving door as automatic capture mechanism.
sectors.capture_bar: NOT MET for blanket claim; hypothesis remains open sector-by-sector.
sectors.arkansas_note: No AR geography required for this literature slice.

sectors.name: Electric utilities (authorized ROE / contributions)
sectors.what_established: Peer-reviewed association between utility political strategy / institutional design and rate-case outcomes; WP PUHCA effect still provisional.
sectors.what_not_established: Peer-reviewed confirmation of Van Orden DiD as settled; Level-5 capture; ROE premium solely from contributions.
sectors.capture_bar: NOT MET — PARTIALLY CONFIRMED association only.
sectors.arkansas_note: Future AR PSC modules could use designated set if state regulator questions arise.

sectors.name: Pharmaceuticals / drug safety regulation
sectors.evidence_type: MECHANISM TEST — limited capture in studied Vioxx case
sectors.what_established: High-profile scandals labeled 'capture' can fail mechanism tests (revolving door, information overload, culture) under process tracing.
sectors.what_not_established: That pharma markets are free of industry influence; opposite extreme also unwarranted.
sectors.capture_bar: Casual capture labeling REJECTED for this case; keep mechanism discipline.

sectors.name: Patent examination revolving door (contrast sector)
sectors.what_established: Revolving-door effects appear sector-dependent: suggestive in patent examination WP; not supported as quid-pro-quo in banking peer-reviewed flows.

sectors.name: Agriculture / commodity regulation
sectors.evidence_type: MIXED — association (crop insurance coalitions) + contrary (electoral > lobby; COOL trade CF)
sectors.what_established: Agriculture is not a unitary interest; electoral incentives dominate lobbying for protection votes; crop-insurance history shows coalitions; payment incidence is program/size specific.
sectors.what_not_established: Sector-wide capture; lobby-primary Farm Bill causation; family-farm benefit from aggregate spending.
sectors.arkansas_note: Mississippi County available in designated set if future question requires — not used this slice.

synthesis.cc_hyp_003_d_update: Utilities association deepened with independent peer-reviewed sources; agriculture gap closed with first dossier showing competing interests. National capture claim still not earned.
synthesis.reason_not_promoted: Graduated model: activity/association in places; Level-5 capture nowhere in this slice.
synthesis.recommended_public_language: We can show political activity, some associations, and institutional counterweights — not that corporations control regulators or that agriculture is a single captured lobby.
